snippet.title: Chair Debiti Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for my first game, Chair Debiti. It is the first roguelike chair-builder where you craft lucrative combos by customizing your chair and buying various items. The game is set to release on September 15th, but until then you can play the demo and wishlist on steam. 

Steam Storepage: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967160/Chair_Debiti/
